1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Had Laju (Tanjakan Bestari

Perdana) 2026.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 22 Januari 2026.

Larangan

2. (1) Pemanduan kenderaan motor dengan kelajuan yang lebih daripada

had laju yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2) Jadual Pertama di atas jalan yang dinyatakan

dalam ruang (1) Jadual itu dilarang.

(2) Jalan dengan had laju yang dinyatakan dalam subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan

dalam peta dalam Jadual Kedua.

JADUAL KEDUA

[Subperenggan 2(2)]

PETA TANJAKAN BESTARI PERDANA

Dibuat 20 Januari 2026

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/26 Jld. 2; PN(PU2)391/JLD.55]

 DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

 Menteri Kerja Raya

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

SPEED LIMIT (BESTARI PERDANA RAMP) ORDER 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(2) of the

Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Speed Limit (Bestari Perdana Ramp)

Order 2026.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 22 January 2026.

Prohibition

2. (1) The driving of motor vehicles at a speed greater than the speed limit

specified in column (2) of the First Schedule on the road specified in column (1)

of that Schedule is prohibited.

(2) The road with the speed limit specified in subparagraph (1) is shown on the

map in the Second Schedule.

FIRST SCHEDULE

[Subparagraph 2(1)]

(1)

Road

(2)

Speed limit

(km/h)

The part of the road known as the Bestari Perdana Ramp

commencing from—

(a) kilometre 0.1 link road to J10 at coordinates

N -58842.747, E 44791.341 of the Rectified Skew

Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric Datum of Malaysia

(GDM2000) Grid and ending at kilometre 5.1 PGC at

coordinates N -59492.582, E 44901.728 of the Rectified

Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric Datum of

Malaysia (GDM2000) Grid; and

(b) kilometre 5.2 PGC at coordinate N -59370.181,

E 44901.582 of the Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO)

Geocentric Datum of Malaysia (GDM2000) Grid and

ending at kilometre 0.6 link road to J10 at coordinates

N -58879.247, E 44785.564 of the Rectified Skew

Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric Datum of Malaysia

(GDM2000) Grid.
